name: camoufox-agent
description: Camoufox browser automation for agents, derived from camoufox-mcp (MIT; MCP stdio + HTTP/REST server, persistent profiles, flows, cron, live view)
author: Jul879n

scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc && node scripts/bundle-vendor.mjs && node scripts/bundle-lite.mjs && node scripts/build-lite-pkg.mjs && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.js',0o755)"
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node tests/unit_policy.mjs && node tests/unit_private_host_errors.mjs && node tests/unit_navigation.mjs && node tests/unit_sequence.mjs && node tests/unit_snapshot.mjs && node tests/unit_sqlite_shim.mjs && node tests/unit_browser_preflight.mjs && node tests/unit_browser_compatibility.mjs && node tests/unit_browser_fetch.mjs && node tests/unit_files.mjs && node tests/unit_sessions_ttl.mjs && node tests/unit_profiles.mjs && node tests/unit_secrets.mjs && node tests/unit_csv.mjs && node tests/unit_flows.mjs && node tests/unit_scheduler.mjs && node tests/unit_diagnose.mjs && node tests/unit_junit.mjs && node tests/unit_budgets.mjs && node tests/unit_devices.mjs && node tests/unit_scoring.mjs && node tests/unit_scrape_extract.mjs && node tests/unit_scrape_http.mjs && node tests/unit_scrape_lite.mjs && node tests/unit_captcha.mjs && node tests/unit_notify.mjs && node tests/unit_live_links.mjs && node tests/unit_live_http.mjs && node tests/unit_output_schema.mjs
scripts.test:local: npm run build && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_client.py --mode local
scripts.test:camoufox: npm run fetch:camoufox && npm run test:local
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run test:unit && npm run fetch:camoufox && npm run test:local
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test:unit
